lukstei-slop-grader-create-slop-grader-r.description: Create custom slop-grader rulesets in Markdown based on user guidelines and SYNTAX.md specification. Validates rules using slop-grader --check.

lukstei-slop-grader-root.description: Review the output of slop-grader, interpret flagged lines and document scores, distinguish genuine violations from false positives, and produce a concrete fix plan with edited text for each real issue.
